topics.purpose: Define exact construction of canonical active source set from classified repository inventory.

semantics.bootstrap_rule: Root bootstrap remains external to canonical definition set.
semantics.definition_rule: Only eligible canonical definition sources enter active set.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Duplicate paths/identity candidates remain findings, not last-wins.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Builder emits immutable source-set snapshot with paths/hashes.
semantics.authority_rule: Source-set build does not accept runtime effects.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.

hard_gates.condition: bootstrap included as ordinary canonical definition
source set depends on traversal order
